The '''Enclave security'''<ref>[[Enclave security outfit]] in ''[[Fallout Shelter]]''</ref> guards are characters in the [[Fallout (TV series)|''Fallout'' TV series]].

==Behind the scenes==
These members of the [[Enclave]]'s [[Enclave Department of the Army|armed forces]] are tasked with guarding the [[Enclave scientist (TV series)|scientists]] working at an [[Enclave research colony]].

==''Fallout'' TV series==
===[[The Target]]===
As [[Siggi Wilzig|Wilzig]] exits the behavioral engineering room with a young [[CX404]] in his hand, a soldier scans him and allows him to pass by.

Years later, the soldiers were seen on alert after the emergency alarm was used.

==Appearances==
The Enclave security guards appear {{in|FOTV}}.
